strongestResult: The hh, transverse-vector-pair and longitudinal-vector-pair physical form factors generically yield a rank-two response matrix for the gauge and quartic anomaly operators above their common continuum threshold.
inversionResult: Two polarization-resolved projective differences recover the two beta coefficients at one energy; alternatively, two inclusive energies with independent weighted-mean responses recover them without event-level polarization tags.

inclusiveResult.mean: After summing unresolved physical channels, (rho_gH/rho_HH)-c_H equals the positive-weighted mean response Rbar(s) dot b.
inclusiveResult.innovation: The Schur innovation equals W(s) times the weighted variance of b dot R_i(s); it retains polarization/channel heterogeneity even when labels are not observed.
inclusiveResult.scan: Two energies whose mean-response vectors are independent recover the two-component beta covector from inclusive mixed responses without event-by-event polarization resolution.

perturbativeDisposition.formFactors: tree level and physical on shell
perturbativeDisposition.mixedProjectiveSignal: bi-grade (two-particle cut loop 1, beta-coefficient loop 1); uniform order two
perturbativeDisposition.positiveInnovation: quadratic in beta differences; first visible at uniform order three

covarianceDisposition.rankAndSignal: invariant under invertible anomaly-operator mixing with dual beta transformation
covarianceDisposition.conditionNumber: not invariant without a declared operator-space metric/normalization
covarianceDisposition.brst: Goldstone and ghost fields remain internal completion variables and are not added to the positive physical spectral sum
covarianceDisposition.equivalenceTheorem: usable for high-energy longitudinal checks only with finite equivalence factors and complete BRST diagrams

measurementFrontier.object: inclusive mixed-correlator mean and Schur innovation over an energy window
measurementFrontier.decisionRule: Claim beta tomography only after the measured response design has stable rank under uncertainties and declared scheme transformations.

noGoResults: exact vector threshold does not distinguish transverse and longitudinal response
tree form-factor rank does not imply uniform one-loop positive innovation
inclusive summation is not projection onto a single ray
the equivalence theorem does not add Goldstones as physical positive states
form-factor labels do not by themselves define an experimental observable
